profile.headline: Software Engineer at Workday
profile.summary: I am currently a software engineer for the Visual Presentation Services team at Workday.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I am currently a developer on the Workday Extend team at Workday. I currently work on creating tools for our end users to help them develop Extend applications that include an IntelliJ Plugin and CLI. Part of this work includes maintaining internal libraries and SDKs to interface with the platform. 

My previous work in this organization include developing features for a full stack web application authoring tool and contributing to Extend's UI platform team.

Technologies: Kotlin, AWS, IntelliJ SDK, Typescript, React

positions.title: Software Engineer, Visual Presentation Services
positions.description:
My work on the Visual Presentation Services team at Workday includes providing new UI capabilities for internal application developers and enhancing platform-specific tenanted metadata retrieval pipelines.

Technologies: Scala, Play Framework, Akka

positions.title: Software Engineer, UI Web Infrastructure
positions.description:
As a member of the UI Infrastructure team, I worked to create tooling and build pipelines to better enhance the workflow of the UI Web team. I worked on a node.js server in order to better enhance the Github development flow of our web team. I also maintained and managed several continuous integration builds that served to ensure quality, tested deployments. In addition to that work, I lead an overhaul and unification of the front-end authentication module.

Technologies: node.js, Bamboo, Java

positions.title: Software Engineer, UI Web
positions.description:
As a member of the UI Web team at Workday, I worked on developing a metadata-driven front end client. I created responsive and re-usable widgets that are used throughout the Workday application ecosystem as well as contributing to the re-design of the look and feel of application. As part of my work, I also wrote automated tests to enhance code coverage in the Mockito and Selenium frameworks. 

Technologies: GWT, Sass, HTML5,  Selenium, Javascript

positions.title: Undergraduate Tutor
positions.description:
• Taught students basic Java and programming concepts.
• Tutored students on basic data structures in C/C++.
• Helped students in labs related to software engineering practices (i.e. version control).

positions.title: Software Development Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Used Apache Pig to pull and analyze statistics from a large Cassandra NoSQL database
• Generated meaningful data visualizations for business intelligence utilizing Tableau

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Coded a test framework in C# to enhance the coverage of an internal test automation tool.
• Developed tests to verify the functionality of medical pumps and related PC applications.

positions.title: Undergraduate Tutor
positions.description: • Taught students data strucutres in Java, using object oriented programming and test-driven development.

volunteerExperiences.description: As a tutor for Boost!, I spend an hour and a half each week helping my mentee with their homework, introducing them to new subject matter, and building a foundation for success in future academic and life endeavors.

projects.title: CrossFit++ App
projects.description: Crossfit++ is an Android application designed to log Crossfit workouts and provide visuals pertaining to user performance. The application was developed with a waterfall development cycle that included the creation of use cases, user stories, user diagrams, and test cases.
